featured_reviews.name: Deepika Bhagwat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Skin service was genuinely very good. Chhaya did an excellent job; she was patient, considerate, and professional throughout the service.

Unfortunately, the hair service by Anil was extremely disappointing. I was specifically told that a senior technician would be handling my hair, but the experience reflected anything but that. He seemed unaware of basic process steps, including the fact that my hair was supposed to be washed twice. I was actually asked to come back twice for the wash. If someone is truly senior, this should have been known and managed properly from the start.

What was even more concerning was that at almost every step, he kept asking another staff member what to do next, which did not inspire any confidence in his expertise. Even when I specifically asked him to diffuse my hair, he again had to go and ask another staff member how to proceed. This is not the behaviour one expects from a senior professional.

I also question the level of professionalism being followed, because due to the mishandling during the hair service, my T-shirt got completely wet, which was both uncomfortable and avoidable.

Communication was poor, and he did not come across as confident or experienced.

Time management was another major issue. Every single step took far too long, with no regard for the customer’s time. Because of these delays, I had to leave with my hair still undried and had to completely skip my manicure and pedicure.

This was my first experience ant Lakmé, and sadly, while the skin service was great, the hair service was a complete letdown. Based on this experience, I would definitely not recommend this salon for hair services. Extremely disappointed.

It barely looked styled at all and felt completely rushed at the end, like they just wanted me out of the chair and my hair felt like straw.

It genuinely looks like no one knew what they were doing. The girl who did my pedicure seemed inexperienced, careless, and unprofessional.  I was shocked by the final result and could not even pretend to like it.

On top of that, the chairs were extremely uncomfortable, the environment was unpleasant, and overall the service felt sloppy and rushed. For the price they charge, this is insanity. Unprofessional, poor quality, and a complete waste of money. I regret coming here and would never recommend this place to anyone.

Side note: My mom also got a manicure and pedicure from a different staff member (Pushpa), and even though her service was okay compared to mine, it was still messy and unprofessional. The work wasn’t clean, and by the end she seemed visibly tired and uninterested in actually finishing the service properly. Overall, the environment felt rushed, careless, and uncomfortable. Just not worth the money or the stress. Do yourself a favour and don’t go here.

This is to formally raise a complaint regarding the service I received at your parlour on 25th November, prior to my wedding. I clearly informed your staff that it was my first time undergoing body waxing and also expressed my discomfort and hesitation, requesting to avoid the service if it was not suitable.

Despite this, I was advised to proceed and was told that any issue could be addressed later by consulting a doctor. Unfortunately, following the waxing, I developed severe skin rashes, persistent itching, and active body acne, which has continued for nearly one month.

This negligence and lack of proper consultation caused me significant physical discomfort and mental distress during an important life event. Proper skin assessment, patch testing, and ethical guidance were clearly missing.

I consider this a serious lapse in professional responsibility and a clear deficiency in service. In view of the physical suffering, mental distress, and additional expenses incurred due to this negligence, I hereby request refund of the amount charged for the service along with appropriate monetary compensation.
